description: Azaan (start) times for Fajr, sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha at a point, for one or more days. Uses the country's usual method unless one is given, and the official authority's timetable where we hold it (Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Kazakhstan, Morocco). These are not a mosque's congregation (iqamah) times; for those use find_mosques_near and get_mosque_times.

asr.description: Asr: standard (Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali) or hanafi. Default: the country's or method's.

date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today at the location.

method.description: Calculation method. Default: the country's usual one.

name: get_prayer_times
title: Prayer times for a place
